incident-bot: Incident 2024-09-15T14:08Z - paging stopped. Creating PIR (incident-5421). Looking for a facilitator and attendees for a 45m review next week. Please reply with 'I can facilitate' or 'attending' and your preferred UTC slots (Tue/Wed/Thu).
Jordan Nguyen: I can facilitate. Prefer Wed 16:00-17:00 UTC. I'll own timeline + action item tracker.
Priya Singh: thanks Jordan. I’m OOO Wed afternoon. Can do Tue 14:00-15:00 UTC or Thu 09:00-10:00 UTC. Please include a short customer-impact blurb in the agenda.
Lucas Park: Tue 14:00 works for me. Ava/Mike can you confirm availability?
Ava Lee (oncall): handoff note: I paged at ~13:42 UTC, escalated at 13:48, mitigated by rolling back autoscaler change at 14:05. Customer impact: ~1.2% of prod requests returned 503s for ~20m. Quick excerpt of the on-call timeline:```
13:42 ERROR autoscaler apply failed
13:48 PAGED -> escalation to SRE
14:05 ROLLBACK autoscaler v2 -> v1, errors drop
```
Mike Chen: FYI support ticket created with Acme (INC-9876). They'll want the timeline + RCA link.
Jordan Nguyen: I'll put up a quick Doodle/poll in the thread. If we don't get consensus by EOD I'll pick the slot that most folks can attend (leaning Tue 14:00). Need two SMEs for the review: infra and runtime. @Lucas Park @Priya Singh can you cover infra and runtime?
Lucas Park: I can take infra.
Priya Singh: I can take runtime + perf graphs.
devops-bot: Meeting created: https://meet.company/room/abcd1234 - Tue 2024-09-23 14:00 UTC - 45m. Calendar invites sent to thread participants. Agenda skeleton: 1) timeline 2) RCA deep dive 3) action items & owners 4) follow-ups.
Jordan Nguyen: I'll drop the PIR skeleton and action tracker in docs/incident-5421.md and add the calendar link. Please add any pre-reads or logs you want covered.
Priya Singh: adding quay logs + perf dashboards.
Lucas Park: adding infra config diffs and autoscaler telemetry graphs.
incident-bot: Coordination: closing this coordination thread. Please RSVP by reacting or accept the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
